messages:
Evan Reed: Hi all  I'm Evan, starting as Product Designer today. Quick blocker: Figma invite shows "You need permission to access this file" even though I accepted. Anyone know who to ping?
Jules Kim: Welcome Evan! :tada: @Marta is our DesignOps lead. Marta an you check access?
Marta Silva: Hey Evan :wave: I can take a look. Which email did you accept the invite with? Sometimes corporate SSO vs personal conflicts cause permission errors.
Evan Reed: I used evan.reed@redwood.com. I can see the file list briefly but opening the file gives the permission error.
Marta Silva: Gotcha. I just re-added you to the "Product Designers" SCIM group and re-sent the org invite. Try logging out of personal Figma sessions and reopening.
Evan Reed: That worked, thanks! I can open "Q3 roadmap - product" and the design exploration file.
Tara Singh: Welcome Evan! For research process, check Notion: Product > Playbooks > Research Sprints. There's an "Interview + consent" template and a recruiter contact in the doc.
Evan Reed: Perfect. One more: where do we keep the UX handoff checklist for engineering? I prefer to attach a short page to the Figma file.
Jules Kim: We add a Handoff page inside the Figma file and link a Notion Handoff entry under Product / Handoffs. Use the Handoff checklist template (will DM you the link).
Marta Silva: Also join #design-system and #product-sync. If you want a buddy to review your first interview script, ping me and I'll pair you with Tara.
DesignOps Bot: :white_check_mark: Welcome package: Evan Reed added to Product Designers, invited to Figma org, and granted Viewer access to shared libraries. Action items: complete security training, device setup, and join #design-system.
Evan Reed: Thanks everyone! I'll finish the onboarding checklist and book a 1:1 with Tara for interview planning.
